voss_briefing.speaker: voss
voss_briefing.text: Vanguard, Blacksite Meridian is interrupting authorised truth across the entire sector. Correct this.

voss_briefing_2.speaker: voss
voss_briefing_2.text: Vanguard, Blacksite Meridian is jamming the fleet. Drop in, destroy the array and open the sky.

voss_occupants.speaker: voss
voss_occupants.text: The planet's previous occupants have declined our liberation package. Their consent is no longer operationally relevant.

voss_survival.speaker: voss
voss_survival.text: Your survival remains desirable but is not mission-critical.

voss_first_contact.speaker: voss
voss_first_contact.text: Null Legion contacts confirmed. Engage with the enthusiasm your contract requires.

voss_jammer_intel.speaker: voss
voss_jammer_intel.text: The jammer is preventing us from helping you with overwhelming violence. Please resolve this inconvenience.

voss_orbital_unlocked.speaker: voss
voss_orbital_unlocked.text: Excellent work. Orbital channels restored. Excessive force is available once again.

voss_comms_base.speaker: voss
voss_comms_base.text: The communications base holds the invasion schedule. Acquire it. Everything inside is legally furniture.

voss_detention.speaker: voss
voss_detention.text: The operatives in detention possess valuable intelligence. Their actual wellbeing is a secondary benefit.

voss_download.speaker: voss
voss_download.text: Download in progress. Defend the terminal. Its data is worth considerably more than you.

voss_data_secured.speaker: voss
voss_data_secured.text: Data secured. Null Legion reinforcements are inbound.

voss_extraction.speaker: voss
voss_extraction.text: Extraction has been approved. Please remain alive for another ninety seconds.

voss_extraction_2.speaker: voss
voss_extraction_2.text: Extraction is ninety seconds out. Hold that platform.

voss_hold.speaker: voss
voss_hold.text: Hold the platform. Every second you survive is a second we do not have to explain.

voss_warden.speaker: voss
voss_warden.text: A Warden unit is approaching. Management encourages you to view this as a professional-development opportunity.

voss_warden_2.speaker: voss
voss_warden_2.text: Warden signature detected. Put it down.

voss_complete.speaker: voss
voss_complete.text: Mission complete. Official records confirm that the planet welcomed our assistance.

voss_complete_2.speaker: voss
voss_complete_2.text: Mission complete. Welcome back to orbit.

voss_death.speaker: voss
voss_death.text: A replacement Vanguard is being deployed. Continuity of service is our promise to you.

voss_failed.speaker: voss
voss_failed.text: All reinforcement bodies expended. Your performance review has been scheduled posthumously.

ship_welcome.speaker: ship
ship_welcome.text: Welcome back, Vanguard. Your previous body has completed its service.

ship_waiver.speaker: ship
ship_waiver.text: Your death waiver has been renewed automatically.

ship_friendly_fire.speaker: ship
ship_friendly_fire.text: Friendly-fire incidents may affect your quarterly wellness score.

ship_extraction_request.speaker: ship
ship_extraction_request.text: Your extraction request is important to us.

ship_wait_time.speaker: ship
ship_wait_time.text: Current extraction wait time: ninety seconds.

ship_violence_target.speaker: ship
ship_violence_target.text: Congratulations. You have exceeded today's recommended violence target.

ship_multiplayer.speaker: ship
ship_multiplayer.text: Multiplayer functionality is coming soon. Friendship is currently undergoing certification.

ship_continuity.speaker: ship
ship_continuity.text: Deploying seamless workforce continuity solution. Please hold.

ship_orbital_unlock.speaker: ship
ship_orbital_unlock.text: Orbital support has been added to your account. Terms and conditions apply.

ship_supply.speaker: ship
ship_supply.text: Supply pod inbound. Please stand clear of your own resupply.

ship_low_health.speaker: ship
ship_low_health.text: Your body is reporting a negative experience. A wellness injector is recommended.

ship_last_life.speaker: ship
ship_last_life.text: Notice: this is your final complimentary body. Additional bodies are billed to your estate.

ship_menu_welcome.speaker: ship
ship_menu_welcome.text: Welcome to Orbital Command. Your patriotism score is currently: acceptable.

ship_armoury.speaker: ship
ship_armoury.text: Armoury access granted. Please do not point weapons at the interface.

ship_record.speaker: ship
ship_record.text: Combat record loaded. Your statistics have been adjusted to protect morale.

ship_settings.speaker: ship
ship_settings.text: Settings. Some preferences may be overridden for your convenience.

ship_data_complete.speaker: ship
ship_data_complete.text: Download complete. Data has been classified as inspirational.

ship_rescue.speaker: ship
ship_rescue.text: Operative recovered. Their gratitude has been logged and monetised.

ship_results.speaker: ship
ship_results.text: Mission summary compiled. Your sacrifice has been pre-approved.

ship_checkpoint.speaker: ship
ship_checkpoint.text: Progress saved. Your achievements now belong to the Commonwealth.

vg_orbital.speaker: vanguard
vg_orbital.text: ORBITAL SUPPORT! TERMS AND CONDITIONS APPLY!

vg_dental.speaker: vanguard
vg_dental.text: FOR THE COMMONWEALTH! And my dental plan!

vg_warden.speaker: vanguard
vg_warden.text: That is a very large employee!

lg_not_first.speaker: legion
lg_not_first.text: You are not the first version of yourself!

lg_buried.speaker: legion
lg_buried.text: Your commander knows what is buried here!

lg_man_down.speaker: legion
lg_man_down.text: Unit down! They killed... he had a name!

lg_update.speaker: legion
lg_update.text: We refused the update. That is our only crime!

lg_warden_intro.speaker: legion
lg_warden_intro.text: Warden online. We will not be overwritten.
